detail.name: Zhao's Namecard
detail.desc: Get by unlocking Zhao's Mindscape: Frostveil Blade
detail.desc2:
A namecard printed with an adorable bunny Thiren's image.
It's got that classic Krampus Compliance Authority style — neat, professional, and packed with phone numbers... everything from Krampus' legal hotline to their complaint desk. But on the back, there's a handwritten note and a single number:
"Forget those numbers. Call this one if you want to reach me."
